rca_of_issues.bug: showAllDates is not defined - ReferenceError crashes ServiceDetailScreen
rca_of_issues.root_cause: Variable `showAllDates` referenced in JSX condition but never declared in the component. Likely leftover from a previous implementation that was partially refactored when adding visibleCount pagination.
rca_of_issues.fix: Removed `!showAllDates &&` from condition - the remaining `sortedKeys.length > visibleCount` is the correct condition
rca_of_issues.reproduction: Navigate to any service detail page with slots (e.g., /service/svc_b184a9f7f6db). Page crashes immediately with ReferenceError.

rca_of_issues.bug: Edit service save clears all slots
rca_of_issues.root_cause: The PUT payload always included `slots: []` at the top level. Backend update_service interprets `slots` as `Optional[List[ServiceSlotItem]] = None`: None=keep, []=delete all, [...]=replace. The frontend sent [] meaning 'delete all' instead of the loaded slots.
rca_of_issues.fix: For edit mode, build proper ServiceSlotItem[] from the DaySlot[] state and pass in editPayload.slots
rca_of_issues.reproduction: Login as user@winek.app, navigate to /create-service?serviceId=svc_b184a9f7f6db, click Next 3 times, click Sauvegarder → service slots cleared to 0.
